name: Machine Learning for Chemists
description: Fundamentals – probability-statistics and information theory, linear algebra, molecular representations and features, introduction to machine learning (ML) methods - linear regression, kernel methods, supervised and unsupervised learning, classifications and clustering, artificial neural network (ANN), graph neural-network (GNN), autoencoder and deep learning (DL) methods, applications – dimensionality reduction techniques (linear and NN-based non-linear techniques), ML applications in chemistry, biology, and materials.
